newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: UNHCR - 103,000 Rwandan Hutus go home in single day.
newsitem.headline: UNHCR - 103,000 Rwandan Hutus go home in single day.

text.p: The United Nations refugee agency said more than 103,000 Hutu refugees crossed into Rwanda on Monday from Tanzania in the biggest homeward movement from the area so far in a single day.

UNHCR spokeswoman Pam O'Tool said this brought to 133,000 the number of returnees in the past three days. Some 100,000 Hutus in Tanzania were headed for Rwanda and another 50,000 were preparing to leave camps in Kitale area. "This means we have more than 280,000 people who have either returned or on the way home," she told Reuters.

On December 5 Tanzania ordered the 540,000 Rwandan Hutu refugees on its soil out by the end of the month. Troops intervened when many surged out of their camps last week and headed away from the Rwandan border.
O'Tool said the UNHCR had no information on the whereabouts of the remaining refugees.
The Hutus, who fled Rwanda in fear of reprisal for 1994's Hutu-led genocide of Tutsis, began crossing into Rwanda on Saturday after being turned around by troops.
